en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a tall, round brick tower with decorative battlements and a conical roof, topped by a statue of a bird with outstretched wings. The tower stands on a circular base with a colonnaded gallery and is accompanied by a smaller domed turret. Bushes, trees, and a stone wall are visible in the foreground. Printed text at the top identifies the place and monument; small publisher information appears at the bottom.
